title: Pixel dissolve
description: A sculptural monogram breaks into a precise, staggered field of square pixels.
useCase: Reveal marks or section artwork with a controlled digital disintegration.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. No image is downloaded. The dissolve is a reversible ambient study rather than an entrance completion callback.
look: Pale sage-grey field with a large X monogram of small dark-green square pixels, partly dissolved, with vermilion pixels marking the dissolving edge.
motion: Mark pixels vanish bottom-first in a random stagger and return as a threshold cycles on a ~20 s sine; red pixels mark the front and the slider offsets it.
adapt: The dissolve is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `70.0` sets the pixel grid, `mark` is the monogram mask, `cycle` the timing, and `rank` the random-plus-vertical ordering that `threshold` cuts. Replace `mark` with your logo's mask; keep the WebGL lifecycle and reduced-motion branch.
